memo.headline: Edge Compute behaves mainly as a Voice AI component, so invest in it as part of voice rather than as its own category.
memo.evidence: Behavior points to a component. Standalone usage is 12.0% of revenue against a 35.0% threshold, and only 8 of 66 accounts are standalone. Pipeline agrees. Standalone demand is 6.0% of calls, standalone win rate is 0.0% across 3 closed deals, and bundled win rate is 83.3%. Self-serve paid conversion within the 90-day window is 19.4% with voice and 2.4% without. Standalone samples are small: 12-month retention is 40.0% on 5 accounts, and 3 standalone-framed transcripts. The data is synthetic. Strong buyer-led standalone demand or a better non-voice conversion rate would change the call.
